subject: Request: verify MapleCore's seller exemption for invoice 7843

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: verify MapleCore's seller exemption for invoice 7843

Hi Ariel,

Quick one — we have invoice 7843 ($42,700) pending for the Dedicated capacity commitment and Finance hit a hold because the state flagged taxable resale potential. To move payment through and avoid late fees, could you send a completed resale/exemption certificate for New York (Form ST-120 or equivalent)?

I attached the invoice and the PDF your procurement team sent last week — it looks like the certificate is missing the purchaser name alignment and the effective date. If easier, you can sign the attached NY form and return it, or use DocuSign (link below).

Would appreciate the completed certificate by EOD Tuesday so we can process this week's remittance run.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_7843.pdf, MapleCore_Resale_Certificate_draft.pdf
From: Ariel Summers <ariel@maplecore.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@maplecore.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: verify MapleCore's seller exemption for invoice 7843

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for flagging this. I've attached the certificate our tax team prepared and signed. It looks like we filled the business name as 'MapleCore Logistics LLC' and included our reseller permit number, but I see what you mean about the purchaser field — we left it blank historically. Our tax lead, Priya, says NY typically accepts a seller-completed certificate for resale but often requires purchaser details to map to the invoice.

Attached: MapleCore_Resale_Certificate_signed_NY.pdf

If you need a purchaser-populated copy, we can add your company name and the invoice number and re-sign. We can also route through DocuSign if that helps.

Best,
Ariel Summers
Director, Finance Operations
MapleCore Logistics
ariel@maplecore.com | 617-555-6622
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-30T12:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: verify MapleCore's seller exemption for invoice 7843

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for looping us in. A few notes from Finance review of the attached:
- The signed certificate looks legitimate, but for NY we need the purchaser name filled as 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' and ideally the invoice number in the "Description of property sold" field to tie to invoice 7843.
- If MapleCore sends a purchaser-populated and signed PDF we can accept that for our sales tax filing and proceed with payment.
- If they prefer DocuSign, please confirm the signer method (wet-sign vs e-sign policy) — both are acceptable but must contain the signer's printed name and title.

If they can't provide that within 48 hours we'll need to escalate to request a temporary credit hold release with procurement.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Accounting Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Ariel —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the signed certificate. Can you please update the purchaser name to 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' and add the invoice reference (Invoice 7843) in the description line, then re-sign? Marissa — would you like me to send a DocuSign link so this doesn't get delayed?

Ariel, sending a DocuSign link now to speed things up: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/sign/xxxxxxxx

If MapleCore prefers to send back a scanned signed PDF with the purchaser populated, that's fine too. Either way we need the purchaser field to match exactly.

Jordan
